- Temporary integration helper is removed and traceability/issue references (#71, #74, #75, #55, #56, #57) are accurate.
- `test-and-docker` CI passed on exact head `54ac5ee`.

Approved from a code and CI standpoint. Hold merge until `fastTrack` has been notified per Issue #57.
